g1.label: 1. A defining feature of the ___
g1.why: The text says cultural diversity has become a defining feature of the modern world.

g2.label: 2. Diverse teams produce more ___ solutions
g2.why: The text says research shows diverse teams tend to produce more original solutions.

g3.label: 3. Immigration fills shortages of ___
g3.why: The text says immigration helps fill shortages of skilled workers.

g4.label: 4. Social cohesion means members ___
g4.why: The text defines ‘social cohesion’ as the feeling that members of a society belong together.

g5.label: 5. Integration requires effort from ___
g5.why: The text says integration requires effort from both sides, not just newcomers.

g6.label: 6. Sociologists say the key is to find ___
g6.why: The text says most sociologists believe the key is to find common ground between groups.

g7.label: 7. The mosaic metaphor: each culture should ___
g7.why: The text says the mosaic metaphor means each culture should keep its colour while contributing to society.

g8.label: 8. The opposite of the mosaic model is the ___
g8.why: The text contrasts the mosaic model with the melting pot, where differences disappear.

g1.label: 1. Diversity is creative; ___, it can also...
g1.why: ‘However’ shows a contrast between the two halves of the sentence.

g2.label: 2. ...more innovative. ___, they discovered...
g2.why: ‘Furthermore’ adds an additional point to the previous sentence.

g3.label: 3. ___ its challenges, diversity makes societies stronger
g3.why: ‘Despite’ + noun introduces a contrast at the start of the sentence.

g4.label: 4. Integration takes effort from newcomers. ___...
g4.why: ‘In addition’ adds a further point to the previous sentence.

g5.label: 5. Not to force people to give up identity; ___...
g5.why: ‘Rather’ corrects or clarifies the preceding negative statement.

g6.label: 6. Cities ___ as examples (passive)
g6.why: The cities named are plural, so the passive uses ‘are often cited’.

g7.label: 7. Produced vibrant art. ___, it has also...
g7.why: ‘Moreover’ adds an additional point to the previous sentence.

g8.label: 8. Opportunities and respect ___ (passive + modal)
g8.why: ‘Must’ + passive expresses a strong obligation for how things ought to be guaranteed.

g1.label: 1. Many cultures in one place
g1.why: ‘Cultural diversity’ is the presence of many different cultures and perspectives in one place.

g2.label: 2. Becoming part of wider society
g2.why: ‘Integration’ is the process by which people from different backgrounds join the wider society.

g3.label: 3. Accepting many cultures together
g3.why: ‘Multiculturalism’ is a society or policy that accepts many cultures existing together.

g4.label: 4. Feeling of shared bond and belonging
g4.why: ‘Social cohesion’ is the feeling that all members of a community share a bond.

g5.label: 5. Accepting beliefs different from your own
g5.why: ‘Tolerance’ is accepting and respecting opinions and beliefs that differ from your own.

g6.label: 6. Hidden belief favouring one group
g6.why: ‘Bias’ is a hidden belief or assumption that unfairly favours one group over another.

g7.label: 7. Right to rule over others
g7.why: ‘Supremacy’ is the idea that one group has the right or natural ability to rule over others.

g8.label: 8. A point of view on a situation
g8.why: ‘Perspective’ is a point of view or angle from which a situation is considered.
